texts: A product designer from Bristol with a background in content design and UX writing.

In 2019, I made the decision to swap my career in digital marketing for a role in UX. After completing a year training in UX design I started as a content designer at Confused.com and my role quickly changed to product designer – and I haven’t looked back since.
I’m a process-driven designer that will advocate for the user and make data-led decisions.
But it’s not all work, I am also an amateur artist, photographer and footballer.
A shot from the President's cup final in 2019... don't ask about the result.

texts: Whether it’s a role, a project or just a chat about design, I’d love to hear from you.
I’m a Senior Product Designer from Bristol, UK.
I’m a user focused designer with experience in UX, UI and content design.
